questions.text: What is the workflow Sentry describes for employers to use the product?
questions.instructions: Describe the step-by-step process an employer follows to use Sentry, based on what the site shows.

questions.text: Which of the following statements does this site claim it does NOT do?
choices: Operate with hidden custody or undocumented wallet control
Provide legal or fiduciary authority over user funds
Require human employees to run the Telegram group
Offer privacy guarantees not publicly disclosed

questions.text: The site shows a three-step workflow: Enable → Fund → Verify. What is the purpose of the 'Verify' step?
questions.instructions: Explain what the site says happens in the third step of the workflow.

questions.text: Name at least four specific capabilities Sentry offers, based on what you see on the site.
questions.instructions: List actual product features or workflows shown on the page. Examples: 'Community Q&A', 'Moderation', 'Engagement', 'Reports', 'Playbooks', 'Roles', 'Rewards', etc.

questions.text: What kinds of authority over user funds does the site say it does NOT claim?
questions.instructions: Identify the specific authority or controls that the site explicitly avoids claiming.

questions.text: Is Sentry presented as an autonomous system, or does it require ongoing employer control? Provide one piece of evidence from the page.
questions.instructions: State whether the product is described as independent or employer-controlled, and cite a specific statement or section from the page that supports your answer.

questions.text: How would you rate the overall clarity of the product offering?
questions.instructions: Rate on a scale of 1 (very unclear) to 10 (extremely clear) how well the site explains what Sentry does.

questions.text: What is the clearest strength of this product's public presentation?
questions.instructions: Identify one key advantage or clarity win in how the product is presented to the public.

questions.text: What specific observable evidence does the site provide to demonstrate the product actually works?
questions.instructions: Describe any visual proof, diagrams, screenshots, or demonstrated features you see on the page.

questions.text: Overall, does this site successfully explain what it does and what it does NOT claim?
questions.instructions: Synthesize your review: does the site communicate both its capabilities and its limitations clearly?
